backend/main.mo: Main actor defining types (ShopOpening, Product, CustomerQuery) and state for a bakery app, with query/update methods for shop openings, products, testimonials, baking tips, and customer queries.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades actor state from OldActor to NewActor by adding an empty customerQueries list while preserving existing data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: renaming 'celebration boxes' to 'celebration cakes', updating description to 'just perfect', adding Instagram contact, and implementing customer query form.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing the luxury bakery website components, styling, and functionality including the new customer query form.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes, defining the luxury bakery color palette (cream, blush, chocolate, gold).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, title 'Crème Patisserie', and root div mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component rendering the complete single-page bakery website with header, all sections (hero, why, testimonials, menu, celebration, location, CTA, customer query), footer, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationSecti: Section component displaying four celebration occasions (birthdays, anniversaries, gifts, corporate) with emoji icons over a background image with blush overlay.
frontend/src/components/CustomerQuerySec: Form component for customer queries with email and question inputs, validation, submission to backend via useSubmitCustomerQuery hook, and toast notifications for feedback.
Final call-to-action section with background image, headline, and 'Order Now' button that scrolls to the location section.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright, attribution link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking parameters, and heart icon in gold theme color.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with bakery name and 'Order Now' button that changes background opacity and adds backdrop blur on scroll.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section component with background image, animated headline, description, and two CTA buttons that scroll to 'order' and 'location' sections.
Location section displaying business address, hours, phone, and Instagram with icons, plus buttons for directions and calling.
frontend/src/components/MenuHighlightsSe: Menu highlights section showing grid of menu items (cupcakes, brownies, etc.) with a dialog to view/download full menu image.
frontend/src/components/TestimonialsSect: Testimonials section displaying 4.9-star rating with two customer reviews in styled cards.
frontend/src/components/WhySection.tsx: Why section highlighting four key features (premium ingredients, presentation, gifting, local love) with checkmark icons in a grid layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook providing Internet Identity authentication with login/logout functionality, identity management, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query mutation hook for submitting customer queries (email and question) to the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind configuration, custom color palette (cream, blush, chocolate, gold) using OKLCH color space, and font families (Playfair Display for headings, Inter for body text) with both light and dark mode support.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom color palette (cream, blush, chocolate, gold), semantic color mappings, custom fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), border radius variables, and shadow utilities.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for Creme by Ishikkarai bakery website, documenting completed features (menu highlights, Instagram contact, customer query form) and pending feature requests for text updates and new sections.
